classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: Using GO term GO:0004613 (NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity) as the primary functional annotation for NAD(P)HX repair proteins.
Using GO term GO:0004614 (NAD(P)H epimerase activity) as the secondary functional annotation.
Targeting sequences with length between 100 and 1000 residues to capture functional domains while excluding fragments.
Prioritizing sequences with high-quality evidence codes (EXP, IDA, IPI, IMP, IGI, IPR) and excluding IEA annotations.
Ranking will be based on sequence quality metrics, biochemical annotations, and structural liabilities derived from the sequence analysis.
plan.goal: Retrieve representative protein sequences annotated with NAD(P)HX repair activities (GO:0004613, GO:0004614), analyze their biochemical properties, and rank the top candidates based on sequence quality and functional annotations.
missing_inputs: Specific GO term ID if the user prefers a different annotation than GO:0004613 or GO:0004614.
Exact target sequence length constraints if different from 100-1000 residues.
Specific biochemical annotations or liabilities to prioritize in the ranking.

success_criteria.retrieved_sequences: At least 10 unique sequences retrieved for the primary GO term.
success_criteria.analysis_complete: Biochemical analysis (charge, composition, motifs) performed on all retrieved sequences.
success_criteria.ranked_candidates: Top 20 candidates ranked based on sequence quality and annotations.
